transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I guess… I’ve been feeling kind of cloudy in my head. At work, I’ll look at a board packet or an email from a vendor, and I just sit there. Even simple decisions I used to make quickly feel hard now.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
I don’t know… maybe a little. I wouldn’t say I’m depressed exactly. Just kind of… not myself.
Have you been feeling unusually anxious or worried lately?
Not unusually, I don’t think. I mean… I worry some, like anyone, but I haven’t really noticed it being the main thing.
Did this start after something stressful happened in your life?

Maybe… yeah. It’s been about two weeks, I think. My husband retired, and he’s been home all day suddenly. Since then things just felt… different. My energy and confidence kind of shifted, and then this low, cloudy feeling came on.
Do these feelings seem mainly connected to your husband being home since he retired?
Yeah… I think mostly. It’s been about two weeks, since he retired and was home all day. That’s when I noticed the change in my energy and confidence, and then that low, cloudy feeling.
Have these changes been interfering with your ability to do your work?

A little, yes. I’m still going in and doing my job, but I’ve been slower with decisions. I’ve asked my assistant to double-check vendor details, and I’ve put off a couple of board items because… I just don’t really trust my judgment right now.
Have you been enjoying things less than usual lately?

Yes… I guess so. I haven’t really wanted to go to my dance class, or stop in the little galleries like I usually do. Even cooking Sunday food for my family… I just haven’t felt like it. Those things usually make me feel like myself.
Have you been feeling hopeless lately?
I don’t know… not hopeless exactly. Just kind of discouraged, I guess. Like things feel heavier than usual.
Have you been feeling sad much of the day lately?
I’m not sure I’d call it sad… not all day. More just low, I suppose. It comes and goes.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately?
I don’t know… I haven’t really been paying close attention. Maybe a little off here and there, but nothing I can say for sure.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?
Yeah… a little. My head’s been kind of cloudy. I’ll sit there looking at a board packet or some vendor email, and it takes me forever to decide things I usually handle pretty quick.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite lately?

A little, yeah. I don’t eat much during the day… mostly coffee, maybe a few bites of something. Then later at night I’ll pick at tortillas or something sweet, but it’s not like I’m really enjoying it.
Have you been moving or talking more slowly than usual lately?
A little, maybe. At home I feel kind of slowed down… like my legs are heavy. But then in meetings I’m the opposite sometimes, tapping my pen or shifting around like I can’t sit still.
Since this started, have you been feeling tense or on edge a lot?
I don’t know… not really tense all the time. Maybe a little wound up here and there, but I haven’t thought of it that way.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living?
Sometimes in the morning I’ve had a thought like… maybe it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up. But I don’t want to hurt myself. I don’t have a plan or anything.
How distressed have you been feeling because of these changes?
I guess… not a lot. It bothers me some, but I’ve been getting by. I try not to dwell on it too much.
For the past two weeks, have you felt this low, cloudy way most of the day nearly every day?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been about two weeks, maybe since my husband retired and started being home all day. That’s when this… low, cloudy feeling seemed to settle in.
Over the past two weeks, have you been worrying a lot more than usual?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but I wouldn’t say a lot more than usual. Nothing I can really put my finger on.
Do these feelings seem stronger than you would expect just from your husband being home since he retired?
I’m not sure. Maybe it feels a little bigger than that, but… I can’t really say. It’s hard to separate it out.
Have you been feeling worthless lately?
A little, yeah. I keep thinking I let the residents down… like I talked too big and promised things before really checking the money. Nobody’s said I ruined anything, but it still sits with me.
